analysis:
Examined three change groups.

1) EngineV2Factory+SegmentedBackend.swift (head 24-62) and EngineV2Factory+BackendPreparation.swift (line ~458). The `environment` parameter is now threaded into makeSegmentedPagedBackend. Segment retention is enabled by default (only DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SEGMENT_RETENTION=0 disables it). Free KV segments are kept across requests, capped at min(2 GiB, grant/8). The default also turns on hostZeroedSegments, unless DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SEGMENT_HOST_ZEROS=0. The env vars are operator-local, so they add no new trust boundary beyond the existing operator-controlled DARKBLOOM_* knobs. The security-relevant semantics live in PagedKVPool and the backend, which were not supplied: (a) whether a retained segment is scrubbed or fully overwritten before reuse by another request; (b) whether retained bytes remain charged in GlobalKVCacheBudget/ProcessMemoryLedger, so the 2 GiB free-segment cache does not sit outside admission accounting. Pages in the same process were already reused across requests (T-028), so I found no regression from the visible code. Retained-segment lifetime of prior-tenant KV plaintext (T-028, T-041) and ledger accounting are integration questions.

2) MiMoV26ManagedMediaReservation.swift. This adds an optional onRefusal closure, invoked only on .insufficientCapacity refusals with a ledger-computed shortfall via signalShortfall (head 182-187). Every refusal still throws reservationRejected, so the fail-closed behavior is preserved. The stalePolicy path is unchanged. The callback is non-blocking by its documentation; I did not see the implementation of capacityShortfall or directChargeRefusalSignal. A callback that triggered blocking reclaim under the reservation lock could cause lock-ordering or availability issues, which cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

3) MiMoV26NativeLoadTransaction.swift (patch only). It passes budget.directChargeRefusalSignal() into both reservation constructors, and no other behavior changes.

No findings. The threat model's T-028 and T-041 text may need a note on retained free segments if the retention behavior is confirmed.
